Parliamentary Session Begins, Himachal Assembly Session Announced

The monsoon session of Parliament commenced on July 20. Separately, the monsoon session of the Himachal Pradesh Assembly is scheduled to begin on August 21. One report indicated a potential introduction of a foreign funding amendment bill in Parliament next week.
